intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Seattle for 2026, and here is what he found: 56 family events, 29 of them free. New in this update: Holiday Magic at Swansons Nursery (from November 7), The Toy Room Holiday Pop-Up at Fog Room (from November 15) and Westlake Park Holiday Carousel (from November 27). We check every date on the host’s own website or an official city calendar, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Washington Christmas events for kids guide.

Planning Christmas Eve in Seattle? See Christmas Eve service times in Seattle.

What Rally found in Seattle

  • 56 Christmas events for kids in Seattle
  • 29 free to attend
  • Meet Santa: Holiday Magic at Swansons Nursery (from November 7), The Toy Room Holiday Pop-Up at Fog Room (from November 15) and Christmas Towne at Westlake Center (from November 27)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Christmas Ship Bonfires at Seattle Parks (from November 27)
  • Also on the list: 13 shows, 8 light displays and 9 craft or cookie events
  • New events in this update run November 7 to January 3
  • Every date checked on the host’s own site or an official city calendar on Nov 26
